description: A human approves a governed plan — a scoped, time-bounded set of future actions across named agents. Returns a plan_id and JTI that agents use to request delegation receipts via pl_delegate. Scope patterns support wildcards: 'build:*' authorizes any action starting with 'build:'.

approver.description: Human identity approving the plan (email or user ID)

delegates_to.description: Agent IDs allowed to delegate under this plan (null = any agent)

requires_checkpoint.description: Action patterns requiring explicit human re-approval before execution

scope.description: Wildcard action patterns authorized under this plan (e.g. ['build:*', 'deploy:staging'])

name: pl_create_plan
